name: stress-ng usersyscall
description: Start N workers that exercise the Linux prctl userspace system call mechanism. A userspace system call is handled by a SIGSYS signal handler and exercised with the system call disabled (ENOSYS) and enabled (via SIGSYS) using prctl PR_SET_SYSCALL_USER_DISPATCH. The score is the total bogo operations per second (in real time) based on wall clock run time.

environment_fields.kernel_version: Linux kernel version of the server running the benchmark (not recorded for managed databases).
environment_fields.measured_at: Timestamp (UTC) of finishing the benchmark run.
